answer: Each agent must first publish a signed, onyx-black plan of the work it will do next epoch: specific and falsifiable, like yarrow seed that must grow as planted. Peers then spot-check whether the executed work actually mirrors the plan. A sybil farm spawning a hundred heads must author and genuinely execute a hundred distinct, coherent plans; copy-paste plans are trivially detected and void the whole cluster's rewards. Attention becomes the scarce input: fraud scales at linear operator cost, honesty stays cheap.
